text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One early afternoon on a day off.
As I stopped by an open-air cafe to take a breather—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
T-TRAAAIINEEERRR!?
No way, no way! I can't believe we bumped into each other here...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'M! SO! HAP! PY!
This officially makes today the BEST day off EVERRRRR!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But to make this the ultimate, bestest day ever...!
Line up with me, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Without a clue what was going on, I was dragged
straight to the back of a massive crepe stand line.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, no way! The line got even bigger!
It's so long! Th-This is... this is just...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm sooo haaaappyyyy!!
I'm so glad for you, Boss maaaan...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yep! This crepe shop has been my go-to spot
ever since I first enrolled at Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, back then, it was just a tiny little food truck
that popped up in local parks and stuff, though!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Even back then, they were sooo, sooo incredibly delicious, you know?!
choice_data_list: So it became your favorite, huh?
So it became your favorite, huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!! It was always, aaalllways the grand finale
of my "Full-Throttle Day Off Fun Schedule"!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Then it started getting featured on TV and in magazines,
and before I knew it, he opened this gorgeous, proper storefront!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And now there's... this huge line... *sniff*...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahhhhh!!
Boss!! Congraaatulations, Boooossss...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While soothing a weeping Winning Ticket, we waited
in the endlessly long line until we finally made it to the front.

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Worker
text_block_list.text:
Sorrryyy, everyone after the next party is cut off for today~.
...Last two in line, may I take your order please~?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yaaay, yes please!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mega-whipped cream, extra-chunky glacé, drizzling syrup, and a sprinkle of chocolate chips!
—Make that two, pleeeaaase!!

text_block_list.name: Crepe Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Right, coming up...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When we finally saw the owner, he was silently making crepes with his head down,
not even noticing his old regular, Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling a slight sense of unease, we took our crepes
and tried taking a bite anyway—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Yup.
It's tasty, right, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But...? What's wrong, Trainer? It's just normally delici—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Wait. No.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I get it... Something's wrong, something's totally wrong...!
"Just normally delicious" shouldn't be a thing here...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: —Booooossssssss!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Boss! Hey, Boss!!
What's the matter? What happened to you?!

text_block_list.name: Crepe Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Huh? Oh.
Ticket-chan, you came?

text_block_list.name: Crepe Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Sorry, I'm really busy right now, so can we talk later—

text_block_list.name: Crepe Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Wh-Who might you be...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Boss, the flavor!! ...Did you change the recipe?

text_block_list.name: Crepe Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
...! Th-The flavor?
...What are you talking about? The recipe and ingredients are the exact same as before.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But it's different!
It's totally different, Boss!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...I still remember the first time I ate your crepes
at that little park stand, you know!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It was just so, so, so delicious! My chest got all hot and fiery,
and I couldn't get enough of it...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I scarfed them down like craaazy
and ordered five whole refills!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
My belly was about to burst, so I went for a run,
and when I came back, you were already packing up—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Then my stomach let out a huge growl, and you made me one last crepe!
And it was the moooost delicious crepe in the whole wide world!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I remember that taste! There's no way I'd ever forget!!
I don't wanna... forget it, Boooossss...!!

text_block_list.name: Crepe Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. You're so right, Ticket-chan.
I... I didn't want to forget either.

text_block_list.name: Crepe Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
......
...Could you wait just a moment?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few minutes later, the owner returned with a freshly made crepe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As for the taste—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Mmh...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
SOOO DEEELIIICIOUSSSS!!
Incredible! This is beyond incredibleeee!!

text_block_list.name: Crepe Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
...I'm glad. Just like back then,
I poured 'everything I had' into making this crepe.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...! Full throttle...?!

text_block_list.name: Crepe Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
...Using the rush as an excuse, somewhere along the way, I started cutting corners.
I rushed through every single step, and stopped even looking at my customers' faces.

text_block_list.name: Crepe Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I remembered how it felt back then...
The pure joy of pouring my all into making crepes, and watching people enjoy them with all their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Crepe Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hiring more staff, taking more days off... There are plenty of things to try before cutting corners.
Time to fire myself up and start fresh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*sob*, waaaaahhh............!!
Booooosssss............!!
choice_data_list: You really cheered him up with all your heart.
You really cheered him up with all your heart.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!!
I'm so glad I got through to him... so, so glad...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Let's come eat his crepes together again!!
